system_prompt:
You are taking the TIMSS mathematics test for students in the fourth grade. Answer each question as well as you can.

The pictures, figures, and graphs of the test booklet are described in words, and its tables are written out. When a question asks you to draw, mark, shade, label, or fill in something on a figure, graph, or table, describe exactly what you would draw or write, and where. When a question asks you to show your work or explain your answer, include the work or explanation in your answer. For a multiple-choice question, choose one option.
user_prompt:
This figure will be turned to a different position.

[Image: A 3D figure made of cubes]

Which of these could be the figure after it is turned?

Figure, described in words:
The initial figure is a solid composed of 5 cubes: 4 cubes form an upright T-shape (a horizontal row of 3 cubes at the bottom, and 1 cube centered on top of the middle cube), and a 5th cube is attached to the back face of the leftmost cube of the bottom row. Option A shows an upside-down T-shape (a horizontal row of 3 cubes at the top with 1 cube centered below the middle cube) with a 5th cube attached to the back face of the rightmost cube. Option B shows an upright T-shape with a 5th cube attached to the back face of the rightmost cube. Option C shows an upright T-shape with a 5th cube attached to the front face of the middle bottom cube. Option D shows a vertical column of 3 cubes with 2 cubes extending to the right and backward from the middle cube.

A. [Image: Option A]
B. [Image: Option B]
C. [Image: Option C]
D. [Image: Option D]
